versions.title: Dread Colossus art complete

groups.name: Raid boss
items: Dread Colossus now uses six-facing layered art with moving limbs, cleave, impact, enrage and summon effects.
Enrage and skeleton summon effects follow actual phase thresholds. All eight animation and gameplay checks passed.

commits: Complete Dread Colossus layered raid boss and phase effects

versions.title: Iron Clan faction art complete

groups.name: Art and animation
items: All 16 Iron Clan units have six-facing layered rigs, animated equipment and matching ability effects.
Siege engines have separate wheels and launcher recoil; firearms use aimed shooting poses.

groups.name: Verified gameplay
items: Effects follow actual stuns, chains, retaliation, Edge, Cage, Vein, walls, flares and positive Forge Master repairs.
All 16 passed pose, bounds, gameplay, pause, fog visibility and zoom checks. Test with ?arttest=factions&faction=iron.

commits: Complete all 16 Iron Clan layered rigs and ability effects

versions.title: Wilds faction art complete

groups.name: Art and animation
items: All 17 Wilds units now have six-facing layered character or creature rigs and associated spell effects.
Separate limbs, equipment, wings and mounts animate during movement, attacks, damage and death.

groups.name: Verified gameplay
items: Effects follow actual regrowth, healing, roots, traps, flare, mimic, herd and gale outcomes.
All 17 passed pose, source bounds, gameplay, pause, fog visibility and zoom checks. Test the complete faction with ?arttest=factions&faction=wilds.

commits: Complete all 17 Wilds layered unit rigs and ability effects

versions.title: Infernal: complete layered faction artwork

groups.name: Visuals
items: All 14 Infernal units now use layered six-direction artwork and matching combat effects.
Dragon, Phoenix, Hellhound and Imps use creature rigs with separately moving wings, tails and legs. Imp squads retain their three-member formation.
Eye of Ruin has a separate eye, casing and animated wings; casters and bosses have moving equipment and spell effects.
Effects follow real fire damage, Hellgate summons, Immolation, Phoenix rebirth, Wall of Flame, pulling hooks and Devil's Bargain.
Full-faction test links appear as each roster becomes complete. The workshop reports each rig's actual piece count.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Effect impacts follow targets after Hellbinder pulls them. Burn effects appear only when damage is applied.
Creature effects respect fog, pause and zoom; source art remains separate from gameplay rules.

commits: Complete Infernal faction layered art and creature animation

versions.title: Undead: complete layered faction artwork

groups.name: Visuals
items: All 15 Undead units now have layered six-direction artwork and matching combat effects.
Skeletal riders have separate mounts. Ghosts hover, the Wisp uses drifting flame pieces, and Bone Legion retains its three-soldier formation.
Effects follow real summons, resurrection, Wither, plague damage, scouting flares, and destroyed skeletons.
The full Undead faction is available in the art test match and animation workshop.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Lich summon effects now appear only after a skeleton is successfully created.
Flexible piece proportions improve unusual bodies without stretching their armor or pelvis.
Pyromancer fireballs use the shared effect renderer for consistent visibility, pause, and scaling.

commits: Complete Undead faction layered art and ability effects

versions.title: Vampires: complete layered faction artwork

groups.name: Visuals
items: All 16 Vampire units now have six-direction layered artwork, animated equipment and matching combat effects.
Bat swarms retain three members; the Bat King has a separate bat rig. Warlock transformation and the Blood Hunter mount are animated.
Drain, tether, charm, concealment, healing and mana effects follow successful gameplay events.
Preview the full faction with ?arttest=factions&faction=vamp or inspect individual poses in the animation workshop.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Updated art files use revisioned URLs so corrected atlases refresh on clients.
Effects respect fog, pause and match cleanup; unit artwork scales with board zoom.

commits: Complete Vampire faction layered art and combat effects

versions.title: Kingdom: complete layered character artwork

groups.name: Visuals
items: All 17 Kingdom units now use six-direction layered artwork with animated body parts and separate equipment.
Outriders have articulated horses and seated riders. High Seraphs have separate wings and halos. Soldier squads retain their three-member formations.
New attack, projectile, healing, spell, aura and movement effects follow real combat events, including elite cinematic attacks.
The animation workshop previews each available character's directions and movable parts. A Kingdom test match places the complete faction on both sides.
Updated terrain and the existing Pyromancer, Bloodblade and Necromancer art pilots are included. Other faction overhauls are still in progress.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Character artwork scales consistently with board zoom. Weapon animation canvases have extra room for long equipment.
Local battles pause through the in-game menu, including pending AI turns. Online matches continue while the menu is open.
New effects respect fog visibility, pause, reduced-motion settings and match cleanup.

commits: Complete Kingdom layered art, animation and combat effects

versions.title: No attacks into the fog

groups.name: Balance
items: Fog of war: you can only attack hexes you can see. Towers, buildings and walls hidden in the fog can't be hit, and attack spells and Silence need a revealed target hex. Flares, heals and summons work as before

commits: Fog of war: no attacks into the fog

versions.title: Sudden death toggle

groups.name: Features
items: Sudden death is now a match option, on by default. Turn it off and towers never crumble on their own, and you can repair and fortify them for the whole match

commits: Sudden death is now a match option (on by default)

versions.title: Tower tap fix

groups.name: Fixes
items: Tapping or clicking the hex just above a tower or wall works again (the new tower art was catching the tap)

commits: Towers and walls no longer block taps on the hex above them
